scope: Ink content part aligned with W3C InkML and the OOXML contentPart contract; desktop Word verification attempted

standards.referenceStructure: Microsoft InkMLjs ink1.xml (inkml:definitions/context/inkSource/traceFormat X,Y,F + channelProperty resolution + inkml:brush/brushProperty + inkml:traceGroup/inkml:trace with brushRef/contextRef)

implementation.part: word/ink/ink1.xml is now W3C InkML: inkml:ink root, definitions with one context/inkSource, traceFormat channels X (in), Y (in), F (dev), channelProperty resolutions, one inkml:brush per color/width with width/height cm, color and fitToCurve
implementation.traces: One inkml:traceGroup xml:id='page-N' per page; each stroke is an inkml:trace with xml:id, contextRef='#ctx0', brushRef='#brN' and compact absolute X Y F tuples separated by commas
implementation.coordinates: Normalized 0..1 stroke points convert to 1/1000 inch with resolution 1000; pressure maps to the F channel over max 1000, so pressure round-trips exactly
implementation.parser: Reads both InkML and the earlier customXml/ink.xml stroke schema; decodes InkML tuple compression (' first difference, " second difference) so Word-produced ink parts parse
implementation.package: Adds the customXml relationship (TargetMode Internal), application/inkml+xml override, xmlns:r on the document root, and anchors a new <w:r><w:contentPart r:id='rIdInk'/></w:r> in the first paragraph plus the _InkStrokes bookmark; legacy w14:contentPart anchors are removed
implementation.save: The ink part is regenerated from document.inkStrokes, so add/remove/clear always serialize consistent InkML
